claims.exactBehavior: Replace multiline regex configuration with actual accepted-rule lists shared by manual-import and import-folder tagging. Quick namespace Add/Edit uses separate literal fields, compiler validation, owned stable row identity, cancellation, casefold column sorting and deletion confirmation. Invalid child input cannot replace an accepted rule; duplicates select the existing quick row. Raw regex Enter/add allows duplicates, ignores blank input, retains invalid expressions in the input and leaves accepted rules unchanged. Raw regex selection is single and double-click removes only the selected row, returning its expression to the input. Both regex buttons expose reference help/component/favourites menus; clipboard choices never insert into fields, and immediate shared favourites Apply survives filename owner cancellation. Nested and closed-owner callbacks cannot alter drafts or saved settings. Saved folder rules reopen unchanged and feed filename extraction; manual-import rules reach the actual local-import seed tags.
limits: The quick-namespace child and deletion prompt are embedded in the existing native window rather than separate Qt dialogs. Native popup menus omit Qt bold heading/tooltip styling.
Quick-list column ordering is remembered within the owner editor; global Qt list-column state is outside this bounded extraction workflow.

Native Python-compatible regex errors preserve the reference warning prefix and validation boundary; detailed engine diagnostics may differ. The filename clipboard snippet follows the host separator, as the reference does.
The simple tag autocomplete/paste box, sidecars, broader manual-import/folder parents, shared favourites editor IDs and export workflows remain separately assessed and are not claimed by this change.
